Items before the meal, with rough estimates:
- Banana, peeled: ~100 g, ~90 kcal
- Yogurt pot: ~125 g, ~110 kcal
- Water: 0 kcal
- Tea: ~0 kcal
- Orange juice: ~200 ml, ~90 kcal
- Milk bottle: ~250 ml, ~120 kcal
- Muesli: ~60 g, ~210 kcal
- Fried egg: ~46 g, ~90 kcal
- English muffin with ham or similar: ~80 g, ~150 kcal
- Avocado: ~70 g, ~110 kcal
- Bread roll pieces: ~60 g, ~160 kcal

After the meal, everything appears eaten. Only a little avocado smear remains on the plate, and the water and tea are gone.

Food mass, excluding water and tea: banana 100 + yogurt 125 + juice 200 + milk 250 + muesli 60 + egg 46 + muffin 80 + avocado 65 + bread 60 = 986 g.

Energy: 90 + 110 + 90 + 120 + 210 + 90 + 150 + 105 + 160 = 1125 kcal.

I included the liquids (juice, milk) in the mass, since they count as consumed.

{"kcal": 1125, "mass_g": 986}
